highlights.highlightContent: The Ab Initio Data Platform also provides innovative data governance features, combining business and technical metadata with an optional enterprise data catalog to encompass all aspects of enterprise data. The platform unites data dictionaries and taxonomy management with sophisticated data quality controls and metrics, permissions-based access, true data lineage derived from many sources, and the latest forms of traceability and observability.
Applications are built graphically using no-code, low-code, and power-user interfaces, and can run in batch, streaming, event-driven or microservice architectures.
It can process complex enterprise data of pretty much any format to and from pretty much any 3rd party technology with any level of transformation complexity and do so at any scale.
